verdict.rationale: Sill's GitHub README documents an opt-in virtual display. It moves a streamed window onto its own display on the Mac so the window keeps updating when other windows cover it, which covers the first half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the virtual display keeping the stream rendering on a headless machine with no physical monitor. missing for 10: evidence of headless operation, independent or hands-on corroboration, deeper docs on configuring the virtual display.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless

citations.quote: The virtual display (off by default) moves a window you stream onto a display of its own on your Mac, so it keeps updating when other windows cover it.
